author: vhegde91
body:
This PR is related to HCAL HBHE data in Run 3. It adds event flaggers if there are many channels in HCAL with bad RecHits or bad Digis. It also sets severity level to HCAL bad RecHits so that they are ingored in PF reconstruction. More details about the issues (Type A) can be found in https://gitlab.cern.ch/cmshcal/docs/-/work_items/315
Related PR for flagging RecHits: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51094

Very high pT jets and high MET arising from HCAL noise is expected to be mitigated.

This PR aims at Run 3 re-reco and no immediate reason for back-porting or front-porting.

 @abdoulline
title: Run 3 HBHE bad digi event filter
